auth.scope: account view; explicit project view allowed for Get/Create/Delete only

request.optional: nil omitted, false/empty preserved; nullable wrappers distinguish null/value/absence
request.identity: exact scoped service/generation/kind/endpoint refs; no implicit cross-API conversion or name lookup
request.constraints: quantity positive int32, explicit target project; project auth cannot target another project

response.mapping: complete source-bound typed model; provider ref field discarded; identity extracted before other-field validation
response.owner: source project is metadata in account and Neutron reads; Neutron Ref.Scope is caller auth view; direct read owner remains metadata; Create checks known target owner; native explicit project filter is checked separately
response.timestamps: direct RFC3339 normalized UTC; Neutron and Resell provider strings kept raw without invented offset

errors.mutation_outcome: documented rejection statuses retain Rejected receipt; ambiguous transmission/5xx are UnknownOutcome; never replay
errors.malformed_success: Accepted receipt and trustworthy IDs retained; protocol_error/scope_mismatch/incomplete as appropriate

retry: bounded safe reads; mutations single attempt

pagination.shape: documented complete provider array; local bounded replay/skip only, no invented remote pagination
pagination.limits: MaxItems, MaxPages, PageSize, CollectionTimeout and MaxJSONBytes

wait.availability: unavailable; acknowledgement is not dataplane readiness

recovery.availability: root Resource/Resume unavailable; request parent/association refs are context, not proof of created identity; no replay, name lookup or adoption of newly appeared resources
